Name: SinZational Several Spouse Spots
Author: SinZ163
Description:
This mod allows the placement of Spouse Patio buildings (2x4 tiles) on the farm.

Multiplayer farmhand spouses will allocate themselves to the spouse patios as needed and take on their appearance and will use them following normal vanilla spouse patio logic (Not raining on Saturdays when it isn't winter, and didn't do higher precedence stuff first).

New in 1.1.0:
Added experimental support for PolyamorySweet

Source: https://github.com/SinZ163/StardewMods
